## v13.2.3

Fix reseller Clients and Inbounds pages failing with HTTP 403, which prevented resellers from opening the client creation form.

Allow authenticated resellers to read the host list used for share links and the credential-free node list used for filters and inbound details. Access is limited to the two exact GET routes; host/node management and other admin endpoints remain restricted.

Includes the v13.2.1 CPU fix and v13.2.2 removal of project ads, sponsors and donation promotions. Optional MTProto ad-tag configuration remains available.
